description: Source code for engine sniffer module, responsible for wave data collection, chart management, and logging within the engine's firmware. It handles initialization, resetting, event logging, and histogram analysis related to engine cycle events.

classes.name: WaveChart
classes.description: Class managing the wave data collection, logging, and chart management for engine cycle events.

methods.name: WaveChart::reset
methods.description: Resets the waveform chart data and logging.

methods.name: WaveChart::isStartedTooLongAgo
methods.description: Checks if the chart has been active longer than the meaningful duration based on engine RPM.

methods.name: WaveChart::isFull
methods.description: Determines if the chart has reached its maximum event capacity.

methods.name: WaveChart::publishIfFull
methods.description: Publishes the logged data if the chart is full or active for too long, then resets.

methods.name: WaveChart::addEvent3
methods.description: Registers an engine event with a name and message to the waveform chart if enabled and not skipped.

methods.name: initWaveChart
methods.description: Initializes the waveform chart, setting up logging, histograms, and console commands.
